t: This is the London Hop Trade War Memorial, in Southwark. It was made by Omar Ramsden, one of England's leading designers and makers of silverware. He was born in 1873 and died in 1939. Though he lived in Sheffield, he spent his whole career working in London. So this memorial is the work of a master silversmith, and it's worth looking closely at the craftsmanship and the fine detail. I don't have more on its history, but the name tells you it remembers those from the hop trade.
